Remarks

The FormatContext class is a critical component in handling media streams with FFmpeg. It encapsulates the context used for handling input and output formats, including parsing and managing media files or streams.

This class provides a managed interface to the native FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVFormatContext pointer, offering functionalities for opening media streams, querying and modifying format options, and interacting with other FFmpeg components.

As a wrapper around a native pointer, this class implements IDisposable to ensure proper cleanup of unmanaged resources. You should always dispose of instances of this class when they are no longer needed to avoid memory leaks and potential crashes.

The class also inherits from OptionQueryBase, enabling access to FFmpeg's options querying and setting capabilities. This allows for configuring various aspects of media handling by setting or querying options on the format context.

Methods

AddStream(Codec)

Adds a new stream to the media file.

public AVStream AddStream(Codec codec)

Parameters

codec Codec

The codec to be used for the new stream.

Returns

AVStream

An instance of AVStream representing the newly added stream.

Remarks

When demuxing, this method is called by the demuxer in read_header. If the AVFMTCTX_NOHEADER flag is set in FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVFormatContext.ctx_flags, it may also be called in read_packet. When muxing, this method should be called by the user before FFmpeg.AutoGen.ffmpeg.avformat_write_header(FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVFormatContext*, FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVDictionary**). The user is required to call FFmpeg.AutoGen.ffmpeg.avformat_free_context(FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVFormatContext*) to clean up the allocation made by FFmpeg.AutoGen.ffmpeg.avformat_new_stream(FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVFormatContext*, FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVCodec*).

OpenInput(InputFormat, AVDictionary?, bool)

Opens an input media file or device and initializes the FormatContext using only the input format.

public static FormatContext OpenInput(InputFormat input, AVDictionary? dictionary, bool findStreamInfo = false)

Parameters

input InputFormat

The InputFormat to use for parsing the input. This format must have the NoFile flag set, indicating it does not require a file path.

dictionary AVDictionary

Optional. A AVDictionary containing additional options for the input. May be null.

findStreamInfo bool

Optional. If true, will call FFmpeg.AutoGen.ffmpeg.avformat_find_stream_info(FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVFormatContext*, FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVDictionary**) after opening the input to find stream information.

Returns

FormatContext

An FormatContext initialized with the input media or device, or null if the operation fails. Throws an OutOfMemoryException if memory allocation fails.

Remarks

This method opens the input using the specified input format with url set to null. The input format must have the NoFile flag set, indicating it does not require a file path.

input InputFormat

Optional. A dictionary of additional options for the input. This can be a AVDictionary, AVMultiDictionary, or a simple IDictionary<TKey, TValue>.

FormatContext

An FormatContext initialized with the input media or device, or null if the operation fails. Throws an OutOfMemoryException if memory allocation fails.

Remarks

This method opens the input using the specified input format with url set to null. The input format must have the NoFile flag set, indicating it does not require a file path. If a dictionary is provided as an IDictionary<TKey, TValue>, it will be converted to a AVDictionary internally.

OpenInput(IOContext, AVDictionary?, bool)

Opens an input media stream and initializes the FormatContext using the specified dictionary of options and IOContext.

public static FormatContext OpenInput(IOContext ioContext, AVDictionary? dictionary, bool findStreamInfo = false)

Parameters

ioContext IOContext

The IOContext to handle I/O operations for the media stream. It is responsible for setting up reading and writing capabilities.

dictionary AVDictionary

Optional. A AVDictionary containing additional options for the input. May be null.

findStreamInfo bool

Optional. If true, will call FFmpeg.AutoGen.ffmpeg.avformat_find_stream_info(FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVFormatContext*, FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVDictionary**) after opening the input to find stream information.

Returns

FormatContext

An FormatContext initialized with the input media stream, or null if the operation fails. Throws an OutOfMemoryException if memory allocation fails.

Remarks

This method opens the input using the specified ioContext and dictionary with url and input set to null. The ioContext is used to initialize the FormatContext with read and write capabilities. After opening the input, the findStreamInfo flag determines if FFmpeg.AutoGen.ffmpeg.avformat_find_stream_info(FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVFormatContext*, FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVDictionary**) will be called to find stream information.

OpenInput(string?, InputFormat?, AVDictionary?)

Opens an input media file and initializes the FormatContext.

public AVResult32 OpenInput(string? url, InputFormat? input, AVDictionary? dictionary)

Parameters

url string

The URL or path to the input media file.

input InputFormat?

Optional. The InputFormat to use for parsing the input. If null, the format will be detected automatically.

dictionary AVDictionary

Optional. A AVDictionary containing additional options for the input. May be null.

Returns

AVResult32

An AVResult32 indicating the result of the operation. If the result is successful, the FormatContext is initialized with the input media.

Remarks

This method configures the FormatContext for reading from the specified input URL or file. The InputFormat can be specified if known; otherwise, it will be auto-detected. The AVDictionary allows setting additional options for the input.
